# Turn more free trials into paying customers

> Turn more Stripe free trials into paying customers: card-on-file trials get an honest price-and-date heads-up, card-less trials get escalating add-a-card emails and an optional one-time extension. Preview the plan, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
